ActionPanel_AddAnApplicationTheScan: Add an application the scan did not find
ActionPanel_DropOneOnADial: Drop one on a dial to set all three of its gestures at once. Only dials accept them.
CommandPicker_AddTheSelectedCommandTo: Add the selected command to the selected action
CommandPicker_FillsAllRotaryActionsTurn: Fills all rotary actions (turn left / right / press) at once
Confirm_AssignApplicationMessage: "{0}" brings its own icon. Keep the layers already on this button, or replace them with the application icon?
Confirm_ButtonStatesMessage: '{0}' managed this button's states. Keep the generated states as normal editable states, or discard them and go back to a single state?
Confirm_DeletePresetMessage: Delete the preset '{0}'? Dials you already configured from it are not affected.
Confirm_OverwriteButtonMessage: This button already contains a configuration. Do you want to overwrite it?
Confirm_RemovePluginMessage: Remove '{0}'? This deletes the plugin's folder and cannot be undone.
Confirm_ResetButtonMessage: Do you really want to reset this button? All settings, texts, images and the command will be lost.
Confirm_ResetPluginMessage: Reset '{0}' to the built-in v{1}? This deletes the installed copy and cannot be undone.
Device_CentreWheelNotYetWired: Centre wheel (not yet wired — see CT support plan)
Device_TheDeviceIsBeingControlled: The device is being controlled. Its buttons are inactive.
DialPreset_APresetLoadsAllThree: A preset loads all three gestures onto a dial at once. Dials you configured from it earlier are not affected by renaming or deleting it.
MacroEditor_ALoupixDeckSystemCommandOr: A LoupixDeck system command or any shell command. Double-click an entry below to insert it.
MacroEditor_AbsolutePositioningIsNotSupp: Absolute positioning is not supported on Linux (the step is skipped there).
MacroEditor_CancelsAllRunningMacrosFrom: Cancels all running macros from anywhere. Key names joined with '+'.
MacroEditor_DelayMsUsedByThe: Delay (ms) used by the Insert / Set Delay actions
MacroEditor_EndsTheBlockOpenedBy: Ends the block opened by the nearest Repeat Start above.
MacroEditor_EndsTheBlockOpenedBy2: Ends the block opened by the nearest If above.
MacroEditor_InsertADelayStepOf: Insert a Delay step of this duration after each selected step
MacroEditor_InvertTheTestEG: Invert the test (e.g. wait until a process is NOT running)
MacroEditor_KeyNamesJoinedWithE: Key names joined with '+', e.g. Ctrl+Shift+Esc, Ctrl+Ü, Alt+Num5 or Enter. Characters like Ü, Ä, ß or # are resolved via the active keyboard layout. Or click Capture and press the keys.
MacroEditor_NoStepsYetUseAdd: No steps yet — use “Add Step” to build the macro. Drag the handle on the right of a step to reorder.
MacroEditor_PausesTheMacroAndAsks: Pauses the macro and asks for a value, validating it before storing it in the variable for later {name} use. Pick a Type to restrict the input (e.g. Integer with Min/Max for a repeat count). Cancelling leaves the variable unchanged and the macro continues.
MacroEditor_PausesUntilTheConditionIs: Pauses until the condition is true. Timeout 0 waits forever (until stopped). On timeout, Fail aborts the macro; Continue runs the next step anyway. Trigger button released waits until the button or touch that started this macro is let go, so a Key Down before it and a Key Up after it hold the key exactly that long. Negate it to wait while the button is still down. When the macro was started some other way (editor test, hotkey, plugin) it counts as released, so the wait falls through immediately.
MacroEditor_PressAKeyToAssign: Press a key to assign it
MacroEditor_PressTheKeyCombinationTo: Press the key combination to assign it
MacroEditor_RecordRealKeyPressesAs: Record real key presses as Key Down / Key Up steps
MacroEditor_RecordThePausesBetweenKey: Record the pauses between key presses as Delay steps
MacroEditor_RecordingKeysAreAddedLive: ● Recording — keys are added live. Click Stop Recording to finish.
MacroEditor_RunOnceIgnoreReTriggers: Run Once: ignore re-triggers while running. Restart On Trigger: cancel and restart. Allow Parallel: run concurrently.
MacroEditor_RunThisMacroAfterA: Run this macro after a short countdown — focus your target window first
MacroEditor_RunsTheStepsUpTo: Runs the steps up to Else when true, otherwise the steps between Else and End If. Target/Value support {variable} placeholders.
MacroEditor_SeparatesTheTrueAndFalse: Separates the true and false branches of the nearest If above.
MacroEditor_SetEverySelectedDelayStep: Set every selected Delay step to this duration
MacroEditor_SingleKeyNameToHold: Single key name to hold down, e.g. Shift, Ctrl, A. Release it with a Key Up step.
MacroEditor_SingleKeyNameToRelease: Single key name to release, e.g. Shift, Ctrl, A.
MacroEditor_StepsUpToTheMatching: Steps up to the matching Repeat End run a Fixed number of times, a Variable number (a variable name or {name} holding a whole number ≥ 0), or Infinite (until a Stop command/hotkey). An invalid variable count stops the macro; 0 runs the body zero times. Loop delay pauses between iterations.
MacroEditor_StoresAValueForThis: Stores a value for this run. Reference it elsewhere as {Name} (in Type Text, Command, or a condition). Increment/Decrement treat the variable as a number; Value is the amount (blank = 1) — handy as a counter inside a Repeat.
MacroEditor_VariableNameOrNameHolding: Variable name (or {name}) holding a whole number ≥ 0
MainWindow_ConnectYourDeckOverUSB: Connect your deck over USB. It is detected automatically. If it is already plugged in, another program may still be holding its port.
ProfileImport_AMacroOfTheSame: A macro of the same name already exists here with different steps. Skipping keeps your macro and leaves the imported buttons pointing at an unresolved reference.
ProfileImport_BackTheReplacedItemUp: Back the replaced item up first
ProfileImport_EnableForThisDeviceOn: Enable for this device on import
ProfileImport_ReplaceAnExistingItemInste: Replace an existing item instead of adding a copy
ProfileImport_TheseAssignmentsAreKeptExa: These assignments are kept exactly as they are. They appear as free text in the command editor and are passed to the shell at runtime, so they start working again as soon as whatever provides them is installed.
RotaryButton_EmptyClickThisStripThen: Empty — click this strip, then double-click a command, or drag one over here.
RotaryButton_LabelShownForThisKnob: Label shown for this knob on the side strip (Razer, segmented mode)
RotaryButton_RemoveAllCommandsInThis: Remove all commands in this sequence
RotaryButton_RunAlsoWhenDeviceIs: Run also when device is OFF
Settings_ActivateThisProfileOpensIts: Activate this profile (opens its Home workspace)
Settings_ActivateThisWorkspaceAndEdit: Activate this workspace and edit its pages
Settings_AlsoApplyThisRuleWhen: Also apply this rule when the process starts, not only on focus
Settings_AppliesImmediatelySomeControlsK: Applies immediately. Some controls keep the previous palette until next app launch.
Settings_BrieflyDisplaysTheNewPage: Briefly displays the new page name on the first touch button (~2s) after switching touch or rotary pages.
Settings_ChooseQuitOnDesktopsWithout: Choose 'Quit' on desktops without a system tray.
Settings_DrawsACrosshairTileOn: Draws a crosshair tile on every key. Ends when this window closes or you press a key on the device.
Settings_ExportThisPageAsA: Export this page as a .loupixprofile package
Settings_ExportThisProfileAsA: Export this profile as a .loupixprofile package
Settings_ExportThisWorkspaceAsA: Export this workspace as a .loupixprofile package
Settings_FfmpegWasNotFoundOn: ffmpeg was not found on PATH. Install ffmpeg to use a video screensaver.
Settings_FillsTheWholeDisplayAfter: Fills the whole display after the device is idle — either a video/GIF or a plugin-provided animation. Stops on any input.
Settings_IgnoresAdditionalTOUCHSTARTEven: Ignores additional TOUCH_START events until the finger is lifted. Defends against duplicate triggers when sliding across buttons or tapping near a button boundary.
Settings_KeepTheCurrentProfileThe: Keep the current profile: the profile the last rule activated stays active until another rule matches. Return to the profile active before the rule: undo the switch a rule made. Switch to a fixed fallback profile: always activate the profile chosen above.
Settings_MakeThisTheProfileS: Make this the profile's Home workspace
Settings_OpenSourceAvaloniaDesktopApp: Open-source Avalonia desktop app controlling the Loupedeck Live S on Linux and Windows.
Settings_PreventMultiTriggerWhileFinger: Prevent multi-trigger while finger is down
Settings_ProfilesGroupWorkspacesForAn: Profiles group workspaces for an app or scenario. Each profile opens on its Home workspace. Activating a workspace switches what the device shows and edits its pages under Pages.
Settings_ProvidedByInstalledPluginsNo: Provided by installed plugins. No ffmpeg needed.
Settings_SelectAPluginToRemove: Select a plugin in the list to remove.
Settings_ShowPageNameOverlayWhen: Show page name overlay when switching pages
Settings_SlideTheSideDisplaysWhen: Slide the side displays when a rotary page is changed by a command or button. Swipe gestures always animate. Turn off for instant command paging.
Settings_SlideTheTouchDisplayWhen: Slide the touch display when a touch page changes. Turn off for instant paging.
Settings_SmoothsColourGradientsByMixing: Smooths colour gradients by mixing adjacent shades. Most noticeable on the Razer Stream Controller, whose panel shows only 16 levels of red.
Settings_SomeChangesFinishApplyingAfter: Some changes finish applying after the app is restarted.
Settings_SwitchProfilesAndWorkspacesBase: Switch profiles and workspaces based on the active application
Settings_TheHighestPriorityMatchingRule: The highest-priority matching rule activates its profile and workspace. Process names match case-insensitively; a trailing ".exe" is ignored. On Linux this needs an X11 / XWayland session and 'xprop'.
Settings_TheHighestPriorityMatchingRule2: The highest-priority matching rule wins; ties are broken by list order. Leave 'Profile' empty to keep the current profile, and 'Workspace' empty to open the profile's Home workspace. A manual profile/workspace switch pauses automatic switching until you change apps.
Settings_TheInterceptionDriverIsThird: The Interception driver is third-party software by Francisco Lopes (github.com/oblitum/Interception). It is free for non-commercial use only — commercial use requires a separate license from its author.
Settings_TheInterceptionKernelDriverLets: The Interception kernel driver lets keyboard and mouse macros reach apps that read raw input (games / anti-cheat), which the default SendInput method cannot. The driver is downloaded from the official GitHub release and is not bundled. Installing or removing it requires a reboot.
Settings_TheLanguageAppliesImmediatelyAn: The language applies immediately and is shared by all devices.
Settings_UseInterceptionForKeyboardAnd: Use Interception for keyboard and mouse macros
Settings_UsedWhenThePluginDeclares: used when the plugin declares no frame rate of its own
Settings_WhenOffOrWhenThe: When off (or when the driver is not installed), macros fall back to SendInput. Takes effect immediately.
Settings_WhereTheAppPlacesThe: Where the app places the key tiles on the panel. Turn on the test pattern and adjust until each tile's crosshair sits in the middle of its key and its border runs along the key's edge. Only needed if the picture is offset or the wrong size on the device.
SimpleButton_NoCommandsYetDoubleClick: No commands yet — double-click an entry in the command list to add one, or drag it over here.
SimpleButton_RemoveAllAssignedCommandsKe: Remove all assigned commands (keeps the button color)
SimpleButton_RunAlsoWhenDeviceIs: Run also when device is OFF
SimpleButton_StatesAreManagedByThe: States are managed by the assigned command.
TouchButton_BackgroundColorOfTheSelected: Background color of the selected state — each state has its own, drawn below every layer
TouchButton_CentersTheTextInsideIts: Centers the text inside its box and positions relative to the button center
TouchButton_ClearsLayersColorsAndThe: Clears layers, colors and the command of this button
TouchButton_ContentIsOwnedByThe: Content is owned by the plugin. Move, scale, rotate or hide it here; remove it by unbinding the button's command.
TouchButton_ContentRenderedByAPlugin: Content rendered by a plugin command
TouchButton_DrawsTheSelectedStateS: Draws the selected state's background color, covering the page wallpaper. Off leaves the key bare — the wallpaper shows through, or black when the page has none.
TouchButton_EmptyClickThisStripThen: Empty — click this strip, then double-click a command in the Commands tab, or drag one here.
TouchButton_FitTheCanvasToThe: Fit the canvas to the view
TouchButton_HoldAltDragAHandle: Hold Alt + drag a handle to crop. Hold Shift to unlock aspect ratio while scaling.
TouchButton_LayoutAreaForTheText: Layout area for the text — drag handles in the preview to change.
TouchButton_PickAnInstalledApplicationSe: Pick an installed application: sets this button's launch command and its icon
TouchButton_RemoveAllCommandsInThis: Remove all commands in this sequence
TouchButton_RemoveLayerPluginOwnedLayers: Remove layer (plugin-owned layers are removed by unbinding the command)
TouchButton_ResetToDefaultOnPage: Reset to default on page change
TouchButton_SnapLayersToTheGrid: Snap layers to the grid while dragging
TouchButton_StatesAreManagedByThe: States are managed by the assigned command.
TouchButton_SwitchToFreeDrawToEdit: Switch to FreeDraw to edit the strip canvas. In Segmented mode the strip shows the three dial labels.
TouchButton_TheSelectedPluginRendersThis: The selected plugin renders this strip and handles its taps and swipes.
TouchButton_ThisStripHasThreeTap: This strip has three tap zones (top/middle/bottom), each with its own command sequence below. Enable Grid to see the segment boundaries.
TouchButton_ThisStripIsnTIn: This strip isn't in FreeDraw mode. Switch Mode to FreeDraw to draw on it.
Wallpaper_FfmpegWasNotFoundOn: ffmpeg was not found on PATH — a clip cannot play until it is installed.
Wallpaper_FitKeepsTheAspectRatio: Fit keeps the aspect ratio and letterboxes, Fill keeps it and crops, Stretch distorts to fill. The clip covers the side displays too; one with its own image keeps it.
